name: mcon_set_photo_from_url
description: Set a contact's photo by giving an image URL (`url`) the backend will fetch and store (jpeg/png/webp/gif, max 8 MB). Use when you have a link to a headshot/avatar rather than raw bytes. Replaces any existing photo. Internal/private hosts are refused. Requires the write scope (403 otherwise). Returns the updated contact.

url.description: Public http(s) URL of the image to fetch.
